versions.changelog: New chart #38 rmst (restricted mean survival time): per-arm RMST(95%CI) via step-integral of the KM curve to tau with Greenwood-type variance, plus the between-arm difference CI - the assumption-free comparison when the proportional-hazards assumption fails or survival curves cross. Tau auto = half of min-max follow-up (--rmst-tau to pin); short-follow-up arms flagged as flat-tail extrapolation. Gold-locked on the colon real cohort (619 subjects, R survival public data) with an independent second implementation; survival trigger words expanded.

One-command subgroup analysis: -t subgroup --stats cox fits per-layer Cox HR(95%CI,p) + likelihood-ratio P-interaction + Overall diamond from raw per-subject data (flags: --subgroup-vars/--treatment/--cut name@threshold/--cox-cols adjusted models). Gold-locked against the veteran real cohort (R survival public data) - full table pinned, catching label-mask swap class bugs at the factory gate. Plus ADR-0001 staged module-split plan, GitHub Actions CI, and .bak cleanup (16 legacy files archived).

Hotfix: galbraith effect-size arcs are now atomic with their readings - when a reading would collide with study names the whole arc is omitted (orphan arcs without readings were unreadable; found in delivery acceptance). Arc/reading pairing test lock added. Includes all of v5.7.0 (competing-risk cumulative incidence cif #37, antipatterns page, arc density relaxation, OR=1 line label, --list-types registry, MCP dynamic chart list).

New chart #37 cif: competing-risk cumulative incidence (Aalen-Johansen per-cause curves, dashed 1-KM naive reference showing the overestimation, stderr event report; real Mayo Clinic mgus2 cohort example) + centralized antipatterns page (what NOT to do, one page, cross-linked) + Galbraith arc-label density relaxation and no-effect line label (OR=1) + --list-types authoritative registry (MCP chart list now refreshes from the engine, drift-proofed) + km auto-AJ mode now points to the dedicated chart.

Hotfix: galbraith label-avoidance deep-branch crash with >12 studies and adjacent outlier labels (NameError); avoidance algorithm upgraded to a vertical 8-step ladder plus mirrored horizontal candidates - zero glyph overlap verified on a real 83-study meta-analysis dataset; duplicate-outlier regression lock added. Includes all of v5.6.0 (galbraith radial plot #36, composite share_y, prompt-cards, changelog split).

New chart type #36: galbraith - Galbraith radial plot for meta-analysis heterogeneity. Precision (1/SE) vs standardized effect, pooled fixed-effect line through origin, 1.96 homogeneity band, out-of-band studies flagged with red circles and reported per-study on stderr; effect-size arcs (OR readings) for ratio scales, auto-off for MD/SMD; same schema as funnel. Plus: composite share_y auto-unification (same-ylabel panels share one y scale), prompt-cards doc (12 paste-ready agent prompts), changelog restructured as version index + recent details, CLI help scenario quick-reference. Includes everything from v5.5.0 (subgroup forest, FAQ discoverability).

New chart type #35: subgroup - subgroup analysis forest. Per-level estimate squares + 95%CI whiskers, P-interaction on each subgroup header row, Overall diamond, right-side est (95% CI) and P columns with significant values accented; bold serif variable headers, indented level labels. JSON: subgroups=[{name, p_interaction?, levels=[{name, est, ci_low, ci_high, n?, p?}]}] (1-12 variables x 2-8 levels) + optional overall; est_label picks the no-effect line (HR/OR/RR=1, MD/SMD=0); log_x defaults to ratio scale with plain log ticks. Visualizes your fitted subgroup model - the engine does not fit. Plus: FAQ discoverability (top-of-SKILL pointer + section-nav), boundaries-first ordering, domestic install channels documented first. Includes everything from v5.4.0 (rcs, DCA benefit shading).

New chart type #34: rcs - restricted cubic spline / nonlinear dose-response curve. Estimate line + 95%CI band on a log-ratio axis with plain ticks, no-effect and reference lines, exposure rug. JSON: points=[{value, est, ci_lo, ci_hi}] (at least 5 grid points from your fitted spline model - the engine visualizes, it does not fit); log_y=false switches to a linear scale. Plus: DCA benefit-region shading (where a model beats both reference strategies, reported on stderr); a mechanism-level fix for the tick-collision false positive that could hide real tick labels; scenario-cards single-entry doc (12 complete workflows with per-flag explanations); SKILL density slimming; --doctor cross-panel shared-scale precheck. Includes everything from v5.3.0 (nomogram).

New chart type #33: nomogram - the clinical prediction-model lookup chart (points ruler, per-variable scales, Total Points, outcome scales). JSON: variables=[{name, ticks, labels?, points_at?}] (points_at defaults to linear 0-100) + outcome_scales=[{label, ticks, points_at}] (1-3, in total-points units) + optional total_points_max. Visualizes your fitted model - the engine does not fit; total-axis ticks adaptively choose the nicest split and figure height scales with row count so dense nomograms never compress. Plus: version-consistency lock (packaged evals.json pinned to the SKILL version), consolidated flag-conflict table in limits.md, per-chart pitfalls FAQ (Cox PH prerequisites, upset truncation accounting, dca endpoint rule, calibration binning practice) and bilingual VERIFY diagnostics. Includes everything from v5.2.0 (calibration curve, DCA, --pub-ready reproduce bundle).

New chart type #30: dumbbell - two points per row, gap-first. One horizontal connector + two dots per row (from = open circle, to = filled circle), sorted by gap size so the largest change sits on top (sort=gap|input|to). Strictly two time points per row (baseline vs follow-up, control vs treatment); for more than two use slope/line, for paired testing use paired. Optional show_values (per-dot values) and show_gap (delta label at the connector midpoint, Pew-style); legend via from_label/to_label; bottom band reserved so the legend never collides with the last row. Plus --repro: after any successful render, an output.repro/ folder assembles the exact command, a byte-identical copy of the input data, the rendered figure, the number-checking audit.json and a bilingual README - same input + same command = same bytes, so the bundle is a complete provenance record. Includes everything from v5.0.0 (ridgeline, --audit).

New chart type #29: ridgeline - stacked per-group KDE densities (joyplot form). One ridge per group, vertically stacked with partial overlap (overlap 0-0.95, default 0.55), upper ridges drawn in front so overlap regions occlude correctly; shows how a distribution shifts across ordered groups in one frame. Same schema as violin; sort=median orders ridges by group median; single-value groups degrade to a marker line with an explicit notice. Plus --audit: after any successful render, an audit.json sidecar records descriptive stats (n/mean/sd/median/min/max per series) recomputed independently from the input data plus an input fingerprint - every number on the figure can be checked against the data. Deterministic, works for all chart types. Includes everything from v4.10.0 (swimmer).

New chart type #28: swimmer — clinical trial per-subject duration plot. One horizontal bar per subject (treatment/follow-up duration), sorted by duration (classic form); optional start offsets, RECIST-aware group coloring (shares the waterfall semantic palette), milestone markers (may extend past bar end: response persisting after discontinuation), ongoing arrowheads at data cutoff, dashed landmark reference lines. Symbol legend auto-added with an opaque backing; stderr fact line reports n / ongoing / milestones / category counts; per-subject y labels never thinned. --alt accessibility text, --suggest routing, demo data, template and real-world example (pediatric cSLE cohort, self-consistency-asserted) included. --doctor now prints an actionable hint when output is a submission format (PDF/TIFF/EPS) without --verify (use --pub-ready for the one-command submission bundle). Includes everything from v4.9.0 (raincloud plot, setup_env --fix).

v4.9.0 new chart type + environment onboarding: (1) chart #27 raincloud - the distribution trio (Allen et al. 2021): half-KDE cloud + box five-number summary + deterministic jittered raw points; summary, shape and every sample visible at once without occlusion; same schema as violin, --stats now applies; jitter (0-0.3) / cloud_scale (0-2.0, 0=hide cloud) tunables; single-point and zero-variance groups degrade gracefully with explicit stderr notice. (2) setup_env.py --fix: opt-in auto-install with mirror fallback (PyPI -> Tsinghua -> Aliyun) for the Python-environment friction; default stays detect-only (supply-chain safe). (3) raincloud.json template (27 templates) + non-Python cloud-edition pointer in quickstart. Includes all v4.8.0 content (oncology waterfall). Feel free to Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page.

v4.8.0 new chart type: #26 waterfall - the oncology best-response waterfall plot: one bar per patient (best % change from baseline, shrinkage negative), classic descending form; RECIST-aware coloring (CR/PR/SD/PD canonical semantic colors, or threshold bucketing response-blue/stable-gray/progression-orange); PR/PD dashed threshold lines (default -30/+20), count fact box, --show-values per-bar labels; patient IDs auto-rotate vertical above 14 bars and thin by stride above 60 with stderr disclosure; NaN/Infinity rejected. Also: suggest recommendation dedup, wizard shape for waterfall, RECIST-consistent sample data (DEMO/template/realworld NSCLC n=26), alt text with patient/category counts. Includes all v4.7.0 content (upset set-intersection plot + scenario guides). Feel free to Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page.

v4.7.0 new chart type + scenario guides: (1) chart #25 upset - the UpSet set-intersection plot for 5+ sets (standard successor to venn 2-4 sets): intersection-size bars aligned above membership dot columns + set-size bars, deterministic size/degree sort, top_n/min_size control, truncated intersections reported on stderr; (2) two reviewer-facing scenario guides - color-guide.md (data semantics to color order to theme to grayscale self-check) and combo-guide.md (composite vs pipeline, multi-figure consistency); (3) FAQ systematically indexed (data/parameter/submission/environment), pitfalls adds rejection-prone color misuse and statistical-method misuse sections; (4) three real-world research examples (RCT n=240, RNA-seq DE, 3-arm KM 36.5-month follow-up); (5) limits.md quick-reference table. Includes all v4.6.0 content. Feel free to Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page.

v4.6.0 P3 polish pack (from the same independent-testing rounds): (1) ROC now draws default semantic axis titles (False Positive Rate / True Positive Rate; explicit --xlabel/--ylabel still win); (2) venn title disambiguation - the bare n=N title (easily misread as sample size) now reads union-of-set-elements in CJK context; (3) cluster_heatmap row-label font adapts to row count (>60 rows shrink one step, >120 two). Includes all v4.5.0 content (12 defect fixes from independent testing). Feel free to Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page.

v4.5.0: fixes from two rounds of independent third-party testing (~180 cases): (P0) missing BboxBase import crashed KM+ylabel / dual_axis / composite - fixed, internal crashes now exit 3 separated from --verify code 2; (P1) validator field table synced to data-formats (no more false warnings on documented fields), significance keys split on colon before series lookup; tests/run_tests.py now ships in the package; --suggest recognizes 5 statistical schemas (10/10 standard forms); journal presets save WITHOUT tight-crop (physical width = declared mm, was 2.5-2.6mm narrow); PDF byte-deterministic (CreationDate removed); KM single-subject groups no longer print a fake 95% CI; unified numeric policy (bool/inf rejected, numeric strings auto-converted with warning, nulls skipped with count); GBK files report encoding; phantom --width None message removed; CJK detection prefers SC variant. Includes all v4.4.0 content (volcano plot, Trigger on routing words). Feel free to Star on GitHub or bookmark the SkillHub page.

**Academic Figures 2.6.0 adds support for grouped bar charts, YAML multi-figure pipelines, Python API, and multi-format export.**

- New chart types: grouped bar chart and several new medical/research chart templates.
- Added YAML pipeline: generate an entire figure set (e.g., a whole paper) from a single YAML file.
- Python API: now supports generating figures directly via an importable Python interface.
- Multi-format export: create PDF, PNG, and TIFF outputs in a single command.
- Documentation expanded: new Python API reference, more FAQ and data format details.
- Various enhancements/bugfixes to commands, data validation, and CLI help.
